The error is src/core/message-bus.ts:367, ConditionalExpression `if (!this.dequeue(pending)) continue;` to `if (false) continue;`: the drain loop never dequeues, spins and records every call of the handlers in its tests, and the test runner's worker ran out of heap ("Worker exited unexpectedly", two restarts failed) before the 60-second clock fired; the complete run of 2026-10-16 on the same file, locally, ended the same mutant as a timeout. It never terminates like the 38 timeouts, and which of the two ends it is a property of the machine, so the error count becomes a ceiling like the timeout count (scripts/mutation-policy.ts) and its reviewed value is the 1 measured. The PR and core policies keep their zero.
